summary: Frontend-only mobile (390x844) testing of Napoli Lounge radio app. All acceptance criteria pass: on-air bar is visible on all 3 tabs with live clock (updates every second), on-air-title/host/range/next populated from base44 schedule ('I due moschettieri' con Simone Papini, 08:00–08:58, Prossimo: NEWS - METEO · 08:58); host is NOT 'con Napoli Lounge'. 'In onda' tab shows logo, 'Napoli Lounge', tagline, play-pause-button (tap starts playback, icon switches to pause; second tap pauses), '● In diretta', seasonal-image, privacy-policy-link, and fits 844 height without scrolling (scrollHeight==innerHeight==844). 'Meteo/News' tab: input placeholder correct, searching 'Roma' shows weather-card (Roma, Lazio Italia, 19°, Parz. nuvoloso, Umidità 74%, Vento 8 km/h); 'xqzzqxq' shows exact 'Città non trovata. Riprova con un altro nome.'; 5 news items (news-item-0..4) with external-link icons and 'Fonte: la Repubblica – Napoli'. 'Social' tab shows 6 rows in the required order (email, facebook, instagram, tiktok, youtube, website). State is preserved: Roma weather still displayed after Social→Meteo switch. All UI text is Italian. No red screens, no fatal errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (comes from LinearGradient/play button shadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (from tabs layout). Non-blocking, cosmetic deprecation warnings on web only.

Minor: On-air-next text 'Prossimo: ...' is rendered uppercase due to styles.small textTransform:'uppercase' (so it appears as 'PROSSIMO: NEWS - METEO · 08:58'). Underlying DOM text is still 'Prossimo: ...'. If the brief expects the literal visible casing 'Prossimo:', consider removing textTransform on on-air-next. Current implementation matches the string spec at DOM level.
Benign: Rapidly double-tapping play causes browser pageerror 'The play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()' — expected on web expo-audio fallback, no user impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is purely frontend (no /api). All UI uses testID. base44 live calls (Program.list, getNews), Open-Meteo and BigDataCloud geocoding all respond correctly from preview URL. Audio uses expo-audio fallback on web. Mobile viewport 390x844 is correct.
